wb-issues.description: Project todo/issue management MCP. Tools: todo_list (filter by status/scope), todo_show (details + allowed transitions + attachments), todo_create, todo_update, todo_delete, todo_transition (status change), todo_statuses, todo_history, todo_comments, todo_add_comment, todo_update_comment, todo_delete_comment, todo_add_attachment, todo_remove_attachment, project_members.
